title: Northstar deterministic Markdown projection v2
description: Metadata for one generated Markdown block. The block names the declared active generation and its machine-derived runway state above the canonical task table. The source digest binds the generation state and the entry set together, so a runway change is never rendered under a stale digest.

disposition.description: Generation disposition is open or closed and changes only through an explicit closure record; complete is never a generation disposition.

runway_state.description: Derived runway state of the declared active generation. Precedence: active, ready, blocked, planned, then planning_required when no nonterminal record remains.
